name: shopify-theme-toolkit
description: Orchestrated Shopify theme development workflow with skills, agents, and standards. Supports feature development, bug fixing, assessment, and code understanding through /clarify → /plan → /execute → /assess → /fix pipeline. Optional plan interrogation via /grill-me, two-way ClickUp integration via /clickup (task intake + comment/status/time updates) design intake via /figma-rest (REST, no MCP quota) or /figma, measured Figma verification with an auto-fix loop via /figma-verify, a stage → main release gate via /preflight, and storefront performance documents via /perf-scan, /perf-client-audit, /perf-apps-audit and /perf-report.
